objective: maximise mean CV observation-level Top-1 over 5-fold GroupKFold (groups=trip) on all 80 training trips

justification.n_estimators: number of boosting rounds/trees; the untuned model uses 300, so the range brackets it from under- to over-fitted
justification.learning_rate: log scale because its effect is multiplicative; 0.05 (untuned) sits inside; small values need more trees
justification.max_depth: tree depth controls interaction order; 6 (untuned) is inside; >10 overfits on ~1.9M rows of noisy labels
justification.min_child_weight: minimum hessian per leaf: larger values regularise noisy-label regions (e.g. the 2 unreliable trips)
justification.subsample: row subsampling per tree (decorrelates trees); below 0.5 loses too much signal
justification.colsample_bytree: feature subsampling per tree; useful because several of the 19 features are correlated (distance family)
justification.reg_lambda: L2 leaf-weight penalty, log scale; default is 1
justification.reg_alpha: L1 leaf-weight penalty, log scale; small default effect, allowed to grow for sparsity
justification.gamma: minimum loss reduction to split; prunes splits that only fit label noise
